programme.desc: S2:E8 Pingu et la poupée | Pingu aide grand-père | La mauvaise journée de Pingu - Le bras de l'ours de Pinga se détache quand Pingu joue avec. | Pingu part à pied aider grand-père à cause des retards de la motoneige. | Pingu trébuche sur ses jouets, fait un mauvais trajet jusqu'à l'école et ne sait pas répondre au maître.

programme.desc: S2:E16 Pingu et les autocollants | Pingu et la sonnette | Le numéro d'équilibre de Pingu - Pingu et Pinga trouvent des autocollants dans leur boîte de céréales et commencent à étiqueter des objets. | Pingu sait qu'il a des ennuis quand il casse la sonnette de l'igloo. | Robby est extrêmement doué pour faire tenir un poisson en équilibre sur le bout de son nez.

programme.desc: S2:E17 Pingu se perd | Les crêpes de Pingu | Pingu qui pue - Pingu fait tomber une bouteille de lait qui roule dans un ravin glacé. |Pingu fait des crêpes, mais la pâte vole partout en essayant de les retourner. | Maman sert de la bouillie de poisson pour le dîner – et Pingu n'aime pas du tout l'odeur !

programme.desc: S2:E18 Pingu et la boule de neige | Pingu et le tuyau | Pingu potier - Pingu découvre que plus il fait rouler ses boules de neige, plus elles deviennent grosses. | Pingu utilise un tuyau et un entonnoir pour jouer des tours à sa famille et à ses amis. | Pingu essaie la poterie de son grand-père, mais ses créations sont moins réussies.

programme.desc: S2:E19 Le nouveau chapeau de maman | Pingu et les déchets | L'académie de luge de Pingu - Quand Pingu et Pinga jouent trop brutalement, ils abîment le nouveau chapeau de maman. | Pingu jette son emballage, tout le monde l'imite et le stand de snacks devient un dépotoir. | Pingu est un peu casse-cou quand il s'agit de faire de la luge.

programme.desc: S2:E23 Pingu s'emmitoufle | Pingu et la flûte en poisson | Pingu jaloux - Quand Pinga se cogne l'orteil, Pingu s'amuse beaucoup à bander son pied douloureux et à la faire rire. | Pingu trouve une flûte magique, mais personne ne semble apprécier ses bruits stridents... sauf les poissons ! | Pingi semble préférer jouer avec Pingo plutôt qu'avec Pingu.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E24 La grosse prise de Pingu | Pingu et les bretelles | Pingu et l'igloo quotidien
programme.desc: S2:E24 La grosse prise de Pingu | Pingu et les bretelles | Pingu et l'igloo quotidien - Pingu promet d'attraper un GROS poisson pour maman, mais aux trous de pêche, il ne remonte que des déchets ! | Pingu teste l'élasticité des bretelles de grand-père en courant jusqu'à être propulsé en arrière. | Pingu obtient un travail de distribution de journaux et est impatient de commencer.

programme.title: Les Blaguo-shirts
programme.desc: Sam et Carly organisent une vente aux enchères avec tout un tas d'objets qui leur ont servi pendant l'émission iCarly. Le t-shirt rigolo remporte un succès.

programme.title: Le roi de la blague
programme.desc: Carly n'a jamais fait de blague et demande à Spencer de l'aider. Il fini par accepter, mais ses vieux démons le rattrapent. Lorsqu'il était en troisième, on l'appelait le roi de la blague, jusqu'au jour où.

programme.title: Sam et sa mère
programme.desc: Freddie filme un vol au Groovy Smoothie, permettant d'identifier le criminel. Mais les journalistes révèlent le nom et l'adresse du jeune garçon en direct.

programme.title: Pitié pour Nevel!
programme.desc: Nevel, l'ennemi numéro un de iCarly vient de se ridiculiser sur le net en criant sur une petite fille dans un supermarché... Désormais tout le monde le déteste, pour la plus grande joie de la bande d'iCarly.

programme.title: Le stagiaire
programme.desc: L'émission a de plus en plus de succès et le groupe a donc de plus en plus de travail. Ils décident d'engager un stagiaire pour les aider.

programme.title: lance la guerre des fans
programme.desc: L'équipe d'iCarly va enfin pouvoir assister au Webicône cette année, ils vont même y faire une grande Conférence questions-réponses pour échanger avec leurs fans...

programme.title: lance la guerre des fans
programme.desc: L'équipe d'iCarly va enfin pouvoir assister au Webicône cette année, ils vont même y faire une grande Conférence questions-réponses pour échanger avec leurs fans...

programme.title: Révélation
programme.desc: Brad devient le nouveau stagiaire de l'émission. Freddie et lui créent une application pour Pear Pad : le testeur d'humeur. Freddie l'utilise sur Sam et découvre qu'elle est amoureuse.

programme.title: En couple avec Sam et Freddie
programme.desc: Sam et Freddie sortent ensemble pour la plus grande joie de Carly qui est ravie de voir ses deux amis amoureux après s'être détestés toutes ces années.

programme.title: En couple avec Sam et Freddie
programme.desc: Sam et Freddie sortent ensemble pour la plus grande joie de Carly qui est ravie de voir ses deux amis amoureux après s'être détestés toutes ces années.

programme.title: Insupportable!
programme.desc: La relation entre Sam et Freddie commence à peser sur tout le monde ! Gibby devient le souffre-douleur attitré de Sam, Carly se fait évincer de la caméra, et aussi des sorties avec ses amies.

programme.title: Je taime
programme.desc: Carly suggère à Freddie et Sam de passer plus de temps ensemble et d'apprendre à se connaître. Sam ira donc jouer au petit train avec Freddie et ses copains et Freddie accompagnera Sam visiter son oncle et son cousin en prison. Mais c'est un échec.

programme.title: Lintello
programme.desc: Carly rencontre Kyle, un garçon très intelligent. Pour ne pas paraître stupide à ses yeux, elle étudie et fait des recherches sur Internet avant leur rendez-vous.

programme.title: rencontre la Première Dame des États-Unis
programme.desc: Carly se réjouit de revoir son père qui rentre fêter son anniversaire avec elle et Spencer. Malheureusement, la jeune fille déchante très vite quand elle apprend que son père ne pourra finalement pas rentrer.

programme.title: Nora, à la folie Pt1
programme.desc: Incarcérée pour avoir kidnappé et torturé la bande d'iCarly, Nora Dershlit est sur le point d'obtenir une libération conditionnelle.

programme.title: Take Back
programme.desc: Zara et Brian vivent une vie parfaite dans une petite ville quand un mystérieux inconnu du passé de Zara kidnappe leur fille. Une course contre la montre commence pour la sauver.

programme.title: Criminal Activities
programme.desc: Le film raconte l'histoire de quatre jeunes hommes qui se retrouvent lors des funérailles d'un ancien camarade de classe. L'un d'eux mentionne aux autres une information privilégiée sur une action qui est censée les rendre millionnaires instantanément. Malheureusement, l'affaire tourne mal, tout comme leur investissement. Les choses empirent : l'un d'eux a emprunté sa part de l'argent à un mafieux.

programme.title: Cerberus, le gardien de l'enfer
programme.desc: Une bande de mercenaires vole la légendaire épée d'Attila le Hun et réveille par inadvertance la créature la plus redoutée de toute la mythologie : Cerbère, le monstrueux chien à trois têtes assoiffé de sang.

programme.title: Doomsday Device
programme.desc: Deux agents du FBI qui tentent d'arrêter plusieurs escrocs découvrent qu'ils détiennent un ancien artefact japonais d'une puissance énorme. Ils tentent alors d'empêcher les escrocs de livrer la pierre au cerveau du crime, qui est un riche homme d'affaires.

programme.title: Terre de Noël
programme.desc: La Terre de Noël a connu des jours meilleurs depuis le décès tragique de Glinda et Jules est obligé de prendre de nombreuses décisions compliquées.

programme.title: Nothing Like the Holidays
programme.desc: Dans cette comédie de Noël émouvante, les membres éloignés de la famille Rodriguez se réunissent au domicile de leurs parents pour célébrer ce qui pourrait être leur dernier Noël ensemble.

programme.title: La compétition de Noël
programme.desc: Après que son père se soit blessé en travaillant le bois, Katie Jolly s'inscrit à une compétition de bûcheronnage afin de sauver l'entreprise familiale de la faillite. Mais lorsque le secouriste qui a sauvé la vie de son père s'inscrit également, la romance nait juste à temps pour Noël.

programme.title: Golden Winter
programme.desc: Un garçon se lie d'amitié avec une portée de Golden Retrievers sans abri. Ensemble, ils empêchent un braquage de banque juste à temps pour Noël.

programme.title: The Last Champion
programme.desc: Un ancien lutteur de championnat est contraint de faire face à son passé lorsqu'il retourne dans la ville natale qu'il a quittée en disgrâce vingt ans plus tôt. Peut-il devenir le héros que sa ville attendait ou restera-t-il prisonnier de ses erreurs passées ?

programme.title: Age of Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Une firme de biotechnologie parvient à recréer des dinosaures vivants grâce à une technique révolutionnaire. Mais lorsque les créatures s'échappent et sèment la terreur à Los Angeles, un ancien pompier se lance dans une course contre la montre pour retrouver et sauver sa fille.

programme.title: Apparence Trompeuse
programme.desc: Sarah Daniels, la doyenne de l'université de Nouvelle-Angleterre, doit faire face à une terrible situation sur son campus. En effet, un crime à caractère raciste vient d'être commis. Dans une position très gênante, elle va devoir aller au-delà de ses propres préjugés afin de tenter de retrouver le coupable...

programme.title: 7 Minutes
programme.desc: Après avoir contracté une dette auprès d'un dangereux baron de la drogue, trois jeunes hommes désespérés décident de commettre un braquage pour réunir l'argent qui leur manque.

programme.title: Yùl et le serpent
programme.desc: Yùl, treize ans, accompagne son grand frère Dino pour conclure un deal avec Mike, petite frappe accompagnée de son dogue argentin. Alors que la situation tourne mal, un étrange serpent apparaît.

programme.title: À demi mot
programme.desc: Quand Laurène et Sacha se réveillent dans les bras l'un de l'autre, leur amour semble être une évidence, jusqu'à ce que les mots viennent s'immiscer dans leur histoire.

programme.title: Mon amoureux
programme.desc: Romain, c'est mon amoureux. On s'embrasse avec la langue. On va se marier, on va vivre ensemble et on va avoir des enfants. On va même avoir des rapports sexuels. Mais bon, aux Eglantines, c'est interdit. Alors samedi, ma petite soeur, elle vient nous chercher en voiture pour nous emmener à la campagne.

programme.title: Vertige
programme.desc: Dans notre monde urbain, le système jette les hommes à terre dans l'indifférence. Mais vue sous un angle nouveau, la ville devient un espace à redécouvrir et à reconstruire.

programme.title: Yulia
programme.desc: Subitement arrachée à ses journaux, Yulia, se retrouve parachutée dans une pièce sans issue avec cinq manettes fixées au mur. En les actionnant, elle déclenche une série d'événements absurdes qui la conduiront à trouver l'âme soeur.

programme.title: Moonkup
programme.desc: Comme toutes les femmes d'Europe, Eva donne son sang pour faire durer la paix avec les vampires. Elle est la fille bâtarde du puissant Monsieur Pire qui a fait fortune dans le transport de l'hémoglobine. Quand Monsieur Pire décide de marier sa fille légitime au fils d'un puissant vampire, Éva profite de la noce pour rendre justice aux femmes, quitte à mettre en danger la paix.

programme.title: La vie sauvage
programme.desc: Arnaud et Nora, trentenaires en vacances, terminent leur weekend en province par une visite d'un parc safari. Tout excités à l'idée de découvrir une faune insolite, ils se comportent comme des enfants et se prennent pour des animaux, oubliant un instant que ces derniers sont en liberté… Entre sexe, folie et barbapapa, le couple ne sortira pas indemne de cette expédition.

programme.title: La Pureté de l'enfance
programme.desc: L'écoute d'une cassette retrouvée transporte la bédéiste Zviane vers son enfance. Basé sur un enregistrement réel, ce film hilarant traduit avec un style ludique l'imaginaire des enfants. Une fenêtre sur le quotidien signée Chroniques du 9e art.

programme.title: Nice
programme.desc: Martial, 17 ans, a fugué à Nice pour venir voir sa mère, chanteuse à la vie chaotique. Près de la maison de celle-ci, il rencontre trois femmes : une employée des Assédic, une ancienne camarade de classe et la propriétaire des lieux. Trois fragments d'éducation sentimentale, trois secrets, trois chansons.

programme.title: Tapette
programme.desc: Alors qu'il est sur le point de s'installer avec sa petite amie, Michel a une montée d'angoisse. Pour éviter de s'engager, il va se persuader qu'il est homosexuel.

programme.title: Journée d'appel
programme.desc: Une bande de jeunes banlieusards passe leur journée d'appel à la caserne de Versailles. L'un d'eux, Chris, arrivé trop tard à la caserne, veut rentrer au quartier, mais Momo, une baltringue de leur cité, le persuade de passer la journée au château de Versailles.

programme.title: Obras
programme.desc: Obras propose, en un unique plan-séquence, un voyage dans le temps et l'espace, une déambulation poétique, graphique et sonore qui traduit visuellement les mutations urbaines, sauvages et irréversibles, à travers la destruction / reconstruction de Barcelone.

programme.title: Ghost Cell
programme.desc: À la fois film scientifique, documentaire et balade onirique, Ghost Cell est une plongée en relief au coeur des entrailles d'un Paris organique vu comme une cellule au travers d'un microscope virtuel.

programme.title: Eclipse
programme.desc: Sur une planète éloignée, deux scientifiques venus analyser le terrain pour ses particularités magnétiques sont confrontés à un phénomène extraordinaire lié à une éclipse de lune.

programme.title: Grounded
programme.desc: Un jeune soldat sans expérience est envoyé à un poste de surveillance, au beau milieu d'un désert.

programme.title: Aquabike
programme.desc: Traumatisée par un poisson, Sophie n'a jamais remis les pieds dans l'eau depuis ses 15 ans. Aujourd'hui elle en a 35 et sa copine Anaïs a décidé de l'emmener voir Aquaman, un gourou-guérisseur aux méthodes radicales.

programme.title: Oripeaux
programme.desc: Dans un village isolé, une petite fille se lie d'amitié avec une meute de coyotes. Les villageois mettent brutalement fin à cette relation sans se douter du soulèvement qui les guette

programme.title: Les aoutiens
programme.desc: André est mis à la porte par sa copine un matin d'août avec pour seul bagage son immense plant de cannabis. Impossible de traverser seul Paris avec ce fardeau illégal et encombrant. André demande donc l'aide de Joël, un ami d'enfance frivole.

programme.title: La bête
programme.desc: Une jeune femme se caresse. De ses poils naît une bête démesurée, dont le corps épouse et violente le sien.

programme.title: Zoo
programme.desc: Des menstruations de leurs filles à la naissance de leur chien, tout est sous contrôle dans la vie d'Emmanuelle et Olivier Teziev. Mais ce matin Léa, leur fille cadette, n'est pas descendue déjeuner. Sur son lit, à sa place, les Teziev et Emilie, leur aînée, découvrent avec horreur un monstrueux cocon. Progressivement le chaos s'installe.

programme.title: Argile
programme.desc: Alex pose. Une vieille dame sculpte. Une situation normale... si la dame en question n'était pas une aveugle et n'avait pour « voir » que ses mains. Des mains ridées qu'elle pose sur le corps nu de son jeune modèle. Alex va connaître une séance de pose inhabituelle.

programme.title: Fard
programme.desc: Dans un futur proche, le monde semble fonctionner de façon efficace et contrôlée...

programme.title: A/K
programme.desc: A/K c'est l'histoire de Kim et Anouk qui attendent un bus qui n'arrivera jamais. Pour passer le temps, elles inventent une histoire, celle de Ted « le flic cowboy » et de « Joe le solitaire ». Alors que leurs aventures s'enchaînent au rythme de la folle imagination des deux filles, la voiture de police de Ted s'arrête devant leur abris bus.

programme.title: Germinal
programme.desc: Renvoyé du chemin de fer en 1863 pour ses idées révolutionnaires, Etienne Lantier, obtient un emploi de mineur. Cherchant à améliorer les conditions de travail au sein des mines, Lantier va pousser à la grève ses collègues exploités.

programme.title: Ratchet Et Clank
programme.desc: Ratchet et Clank unissent leur force, intelligence et courage pour lutter contre le maléfique Drek qui veut détruire la galaxie. Avec l'aide des Rangers Galactiques ils vont se lancer dans une aventure spectaculaire ! Ce duo de choc est basé sur la franchise des jeux vidéo Ratchet & Clank de Sony, qui a été écoulée à plus de 13 millions d'exemplaires à travers le monde.

programme.title: Pets To The Rescue
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un frère et une sœur sont enlevés après avoir trouvé un camion d'or volé, ce sont leurs animaux de compagnie qui doivent prendre les choses en main pour les sauver !

programme.title: Cyrano Et D'artagnan
programme.desc: Deux gascons montent à Paris, Cyrano et d'Artagnan. Le premier entre au service du Roi Louis XIII, le second, devenu Mousquetaire, sert la cause d'Anne d'Autriche. Nous sommes en 1642. Les complots se multiplient à la Cour. Les intrigues amoureuses vont aussi bon train avec deux beautés de l'époque : Ninon dee Lenclos et Marion Delorme.

programme.title: Au nom des femmes
programme.desc: L'histoire vraie de Judy Wood, une avocate qui a changé le droit d'asile américain pour sauver la vie de femmes immigrantes.

programme.title: Evelyn
programme.desc: Depuis que sa femme a déserté le foyer, Desmond Doyle se débrouille tant bien que mal pour élever seul ses trois jeunes enfants, mais dans l'Irlande puritaine des années Cinquante, cette situation est inacceptable. L'Etat décide de placer les petits en institution religieuse.

programme.title: Ce que veulent les femmes
programme.desc: Nick Marshall est LE macho à l'américaine! La clope au bec, toujours bien rasé, les abdos hyper dessinés, ce qu'il faut de poils, un regard à tomber par terre, et bien sûr le sourire éclatant laissant entrevoir ses dents d'une blancheur étincelante.

programme.title: Une famille sur le ring
programme.desc: L'ancien catcheur Ricky et sa femme Julia vivent de leurs représentations avec leurs enfants, Saraya et Zak. Lorsque le frère et la sœur ont l'opportunité de passer des auditions pour la WWE, ils apprennent que devenir une Superstar WWE est bien plus exigeant qu'ils ne l'auraient imaginé.

programme.title: L'amour au bout du chemin
programme.desc: Pour sauver son entreprise, Becca s'associe à Lee Price àla Barbade pour obtenir les droits et trouve l'amour.

programme.title: Piégée avec ma soeur
programme.desc: Une piscine va fermer pour un long week-end de vacances. Bree et sa sœur Joanna sont en difficulté.

programme.title: Les mystérieuses cartes de Noël
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une journaliste d'enquête découvre de mystérieuses cartes vierges après l'enterrement de sa mère, elle cherche à découvrir les secrets du passé de sa mère.

programme.title: Le meurtrier de minuit
programme.desc: Des inconnus composent un jury dans l'affaire de tueur en série la plus notoire de San Francisco. À présent, quelqu'un, ou quelque chose, les tue les unes après les autres.

programme.title: Passion Trouble
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une femme rencontre un homme qu'elle croit être son âme sœur, d'étranges événements se produisent dans sa vie, lui faisant croire qu'elle devient folle.

programme.title: Liaison Scandaleuse
programme.desc: Holden Pryce, tombe sous le charme de Lana, une très séduisante jeune femme, lorsqu'il rend visite à son père, un homme d'affaire fortuné.

programme.title: Le dernier refuge: Au revoir monde
programme.desc: Alors qu'une mystérieuse attaque de cyberterroristes plongeait le monde dans le chaos, un groupe d'amis trouva refuge dans une maison perdue à la campagne. Confrontés à un avenir incertain, des tensions font surface et les dangers se multiplient.

programme.title: Consumed
programme.desc: Lorsque Sophie Kessler constate sur son fils de sept ans de soudaines éruptions cutanée que les médecins sont incapables d'expliquer, elle est forcée d'enquêter sur un éventail de causes potentielles et d'un fléau sans nom et potentiellement mortel.

programme.title: No Strings Attached
programme.desc: L'histoire désopilante de l'accord parfait que passent Emma et Adam, basé entièrement sur le sexe et dont la seule règle est : Sex Friends.

programme.title: Une idée de génie
programme.desc: Deux amis s'associent et rencontrent le succès.

programme.desc: Gaffes, erreurs, ratés, Michel et Michel vous disent tout sur vos films et séries préférés.

programme.title: Blockbusters 80
programme.desc: "Blockbusters 80" nous replonge dans les films d'action iconiques des années 80, symboles d'une époque.

programme.title: Écran Large
programme.desc: Il est temps de faire honneur et justice à ce grand film incompris qu'est Dirty Dancing.

programme.title: Écran Large
programme.desc: La Guerre des Mondes est finalement un grand film d'horreur moderne.

programme.title: Écran Large
programme.desc: Dans la longue liste des films martiens ratés, Mission to Mars tient une place de choix.

programme.title: Écran Large
programme.desc: C'est l'une des séries les plus cultes des années 80, surtout pour les fans de SF : V Les Visiteurs

programme.title: Écran Large
programme.desc: Le succès économique et critique en dit long sur les mutations subies par le genre à Hollywood.

programme.title: Écran Large
programme.desc: La Fin d'Oak Street est le dernier blockbuster de l'été 2026, et probablement le plus WTF.

programme.title: Écran Large
programme.desc: Le film est une catastrophe industrielle qui fait très mal au studio.

programme.title: Stars Connexions : Angèle, Squeezie et Kendji Girac
programme.desc: Les destins de Squeezie, Angèle et Kendji Girac, révélés par le web, la musique et le talent.

programme.title: Close Up
programme.desc: La carrière, la vie privée, la filmographie et les secrets de vos stars hollywoodiennes préférées.

programme.title: On sera 2!
programme.desc: Afin de survivre à la fièvre des mariages de l'été, les vieux amis célibataires Ben et Alice, décident de devenir l'accompagnant de l'autre à chaque fois que l'un d'entre eux sera invité.

programme.title: Hitch
programme.desc: New York "date doctor" Alex Hitchens (Will Smith) tries to charm gossip columnist Sara Melas (Eva Mendes) at the same time he is coaching shy Albert (Kevin James) on how to win the love of beautiful heiress Allegra Cole (Amber Valletta).

programme.title: Juste un peu d'alchimie
programme.desc: Oli tombe amoureuse d'Eric, une étoile brillante du cinéma et de la télévision. Elle va vivre une merveilleuse romance dans un monde de glamour.

programme.title: Country Crush
programme.desc: Un mécanicien d'une petite ville rencontre une chanteuse de country en herbe. S'agit-il d'un coup de foudre pour ce couple de jeunes adultes ou simplement d'une attirance mutuelle dans une comédie musicale sans préavis ?

programme.title: Puzzle
programme.desc: Le film est centré sur une mère de famille de banlieue dans la quarantaine, dont l'existence se résume à prendre soin des hommes de sa famille. Lorsqu'elle découvre qu'elle a un don pour assembler des puzzles, son monde commence à s'ouvrir et toute sa famille est obligée de s'adapter et de grandir aussi.

programme.title: Après Lucia
programme.desc: Lucia est morte dans un accident de voiture il y a six mois depuis, son mari Roberto et sa fille Alejandra, tentent de surmonter ce deuil. Afin de prendre un nouveau départ, Roberto décide de s'installer à Mexico. Alejandra se retrouve, nouvelle, dans une classe. Plus jolie, plus brillante, elle est rapidement la cible d'envie et de jalousie de la part de ses camarades. Refusant d'en parler à son père, elle devient une proie, un bouc émissaire.

programme.title: L'Aventure du Dr Fergus
programme.desc: Comédie sur un dentiste américain (Daniel Day-Lewis) parcourant la campagne argentine à moto pour prêcher l'évangile de l'hygiène dentaire.

programme.title: L'énigme
programme.desc: L'étudiante Holly Teller (Elisabeth Harnois) est attirée par la mystérieuse petite ville de Riddle, en Pennsylvanie, à la recherche de son frère disparu. Contre la volonté du shérif local (Val Kilmer) et d'un ancien du village (William Sadler), elle commence à percer un mystère lié à un hôpital psychiatrique abandonné à la périphérie de la ville, découvrant un passé terrifiant que les habitants sont déterminés à garder secret.

programme.title: Criminals: Le Dernier Casse
programme.desc: Différentes actions menées dans la ville de Londres, contre l'environnement violent du trafic d'armes.

programme.title: Dans la Tête d'Alan Moore
programme.desc: La vie d'une légende de la BD et de la contre-culture.

programme.title: Dans la Tête d'Alan Moore
programme.desc: La vie d'une légende de la BD et de la contre-culture.

programme.title: Oxygen
programme.desc: Deux gars kidnappent la femme d'un homme riche et l'enterrent dans une boîte avec 24 heures d'oxygène.

programme.title: Criminals: Le Dernier Casse
programme.desc: Différentes actions menées dans la ville de Londres, contre l'environnement violent du trafic d'armes.

programme.title: Sculpté avec amour
programme.desc: Isla, artiste timide, accepte de réaliser une sculpture pour impressionner le patron de Mark, un vendeur charmeur. Problème : elle n'a jamais sculpté. Avec l'aide de Mark, elle découvre confiance et amour.

programme.title: Amoureux pour le show
programme.desc: Tara, présentatrice télé en perte de vitesse, accepte de participer à une émission où elle doit épouser un inconnu. Mais en rencontrant Joe, son “mari idéal”, elle commence à douter que tout soit faux.

programme.title: Cuisiner n'est pas Jouer
programme.desc: Lilah, cheffe passionnée, voit son restaurant racheté par Charlie, un entrepreneur technologique décidé à le moderniser. Mais en découvrant leur quartier et ses traditions, Charlie pourrait revoir toutes ses priorités.

programme.title: Marcher vers l'amour
programme.desc: Pour sauver son musée en difficulté, une conservatrice traditionnelle collabore avec un artiste d'avant-garde. Ensemble, ils créent une exposition originale qui pourrait transformer leur vie… et leurs sentiments.

programme.title: Deux chefs et un gâteau de mariage
programme.desc: Une critique gastronomique renommée croise la route d'un chef refusant les critiques culinaires lors du mariage de sa sœur. Entre tensions et attirance, ils devront apprendre à se comprendre avant le grand jour.

programme.title: Easy Girl
programme.desc: Après avoir menti en prétendant avoir perdu sa virginité, une jeune lycéenne très soignée fait l'objet d'accusations comparables à celles portées à Hester Prynne dans The Scarlet Letter, roman qu'elle est en train d'étudier à l'école. Elle décide de se servir de cette rumeur pour améliorer sa situation sociale et financière.

programme.title: Roxanne
programme.desc: Dans la petite ville touristique de Nelson, Washington, le sympathique chef des pompiers , C.D. Bales (Steve Martin) est sensible aux remarques sur son nez particulièrement long. Une belle astronome intelligente, Roxanne (Daryl Hannah), en ville pour étudier une comète, est attirée par un autre nouveau-venu, le pompier professionnel travaillant auprès de C.D., Chris (Rick Rossovich).

programme.title: Grown Ups
programme.desc: Des retrouvailles hilarantes ! 5 amis d'enfance originaires de la même ville se retrouvent trente ans plus tard. Ils vont réaliser combien leurs vies sont différentes et vont vite découvrir que vieillir ne signifie pas forcément grandir.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: Ace Ventura, un détective pour animaux, enquête sur l'enlevement de Flocon de neige, le dauphin mascotte de l'équipe des Dauphins de Miami. Mais Ace Ventura est un détective aux méthodes un peu particulières et au comportement étrange qui déplaît notamment beaucoup à la police de Miami avec qui il est censé collaborer.

programme.title: Le meilleur des temps
programme.desc: Un perdant d'une petite ville est déterminé à avoir une autre chance de gagner un match de football.

programme.title: Made in America
programme.desc: La famille que l'on cherche n'est pas toujours celle que l'on imaginait.

programme.title: Allumeuses!
programme.desc: Trois amies croquent la vie à pleines dents et n'ont pas besoin d'hommes pour être heureuses. Jusqu'au jour où l'une d'entre elles tombe amoureuse... Christina s'est toujours efforcée de respecter une règle d'or en matière de mecs: "Eviter toute relation sérieuse avec le sexe opposé".

programme.title: L'équipée du cannonball

programme.desc: Broadcaster and healthy ageing expert Liz Earle discusses her transformation from overwhelmed, overweight, and exhausted during perimenopause to thriving in her 60s. She shares the lifestyle shifts that improved her health, including the importance of morning light and circadian rhythms, strength training, sleep, and consistency in wellbeing.

programme.title: Ruby Wax On Why Trump Scares Her!
programme.desc: Have you noticed that your memory and rational thinking disappear when you're anxious? Ruby Wax wants you to retrain your focus and attention in a digital world that's always trying to steal it. In this chat with Fearne – live from the Happy Place Festival – Ruby explains the difference between mental health and mental illness, and why she calls meditation 'mind gym'.

programme.title: Dr Julie on Triggers And Behaviour Patterns
programme.desc: Psychologist Dr Julie Smith discusses why criticism hurts so deeply, explaining how your brain needs evidence rather than mantras to build self-worth and change your critical inner voice. She explores why feedback from others can trigger old wounds and how patterns developed in childhood keep replaying in adulthood.

programme.title: Ruth Langsford On Coping With Grief & Loss
programme.desc: Broadcaster Ruth Langsford opens up about navigating divorce, grief, and the emotional reality of caring for parents with dementia. From therapy breakthroughs to the power of female friendships, Ruth shares the tools that have helped her find strength in life's most difficult moments. Fearne and Ruth compare their experiences of mum guilt, and why it's so important for young boys in particular to see the women in their life working. Ruth also reveals the sliding doors moment that led her to her TV presenting career. Content warning: this episode contains conversations about grief after suicide.

programme.title: Zayn Malik's Secret to Slow Living
programme.desc: Musician Zayn talks through the quiet lifestyle he loves in Pennsylvania: painting, being outdoors, spending time with his daughter, and staying off his phone. He explains how fatherhood has changed him, whether he's the parent he thought he would be, and what impact the new depths of emotion he feels has had on his music.

programme.title: Daisy May & Charlie Cooper Discuss Their Careers And Growing Up Working Class
programme.desc: Actors Daisy May and Charlie Cooper, siblings behind the hit show This Country, join Fearne Cotton to discuss how growing up working class shaped their work ethic, creativity, and resilience. They open up about the class divide, self-doubt in breaking into television, and the £350,000 contract clause that nearly prevented their show from happening.

programme.title: What's Going Down In Fearne's WhatsApp Groups?
programme.desc: Fearne shares what's been making her laugh, what's been frustrating her, and the small moments helping her stay grounded. From outrageous chats with lifelong friends to worrying about things outside her control, this is an honest catch-up on the highs, lows and everything in between.

In this chat with Fearne, live from the Happy Place Festival, Candice explains why she felt it was so important to write about big topics like medical racism and fertility pressures, as well as why for her characters come first and the plot is just a side quest.

When Grace chooses her baby, Lanre breaks his promise of marriage, leaving her to face an uncertain future alone.

programme.title: AI CEOs Being Absolutely Insane
programme.desc: Have you ever paid attention to the voices behind the 'inevitable' AI revolution? OpenAI's Sam Altman, SpaceX's Elon Musk, and Palantir's Alex Karp are among the tech elite. They're building the models they claim will change work, politics, and life forever. But when they talk about this future, their rhetoric ranges from bizarre to sinister. From Musk's prediction that there's "a 10 to 20% chance of killer robots wiping out humanity" to Altman's sale of intelligence as utility, things look pretty bleak.

programme.title: Donald Trump's Most Embarrassing Moments
programme.desc: Donald Trump has a lot to say about the world. That doesn't mean he knows what he's talking about. From China to Venezuela and Canada to the UK, watch Trump's questionable comments about all corners of the globe.

programme.title: Gary Stevenson Interview
programme.desc: Gary Stevenson, economist and ex-Citibank trader, returns to PoliticsJOE just days after Andy Burnham became Prime Minister. Stevenson explains why he expects Labour to dodge serious taxation of the ultra-wealthy, instead quietly shifting the burden onto the upper middle class through moves like equalising capital gains and income tax. He breaks down why cutting VAT on energy bills is a quick political win rather than a real fix, and why he believes every government that fails to tax extreme wealth eventually gets forced into austerity, creating fertile ground for Reform and Farage.

programme.title: Generational
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Generational, a series bringing together football fans from every generation to debate the biggest talking points in the game. Topics include whether the Premier League has ruined football, if players from the 60s and 70s could cope in today's game, whether Jack Grealish is better than Pelé, if the FA Cup is still a major trophy, and whether Manchester City should be stripped of their trophies if found guilty. Different generations bring different perspectives, experiences and opinions, with plenty of disagreement and passionate arguments throughout.

programme.title: On The Ground at CPAC GB
programme.desc: Why are transatlantic forces of the right assembling in North Greenwich? Andy Twelves investigates CPAC GB, the new offshoot of America's longstanding Conservative Political Action Conference that hopes to unite the right in the UK. Attendees range from Tories like Liz Truss and Jacob Rees-Mogg to online voices like Young Bob and nationalist influencer Angloid to Americans who have made the trip across the pond. Nigel Farage attended the second day of the conference, and other speakers included Matt Goodwin and Matt Schlapp, CPAC's chair. Watch various factions of the right, from Conservatives to the Reform and Restore curious, fight for their ideas in speaking halls and a dimly lit expo centre.

programme.title: JOE Pub Quiz with TommyInnit and Max Fosh
programme.desc: TommyInnit and Max Fosh go head-to-head in the Joe Pub Quiz with a YouTube twist, battling it out across rounds testing their knowledge of the platform, iconic YouTube moments and some of the biggest names in internet history. From guessing who said which iconic line, to throwback YouTube apologies from Logan Paul, classic Sidemen diss tracks and a final rapid-fire round where they have to identify famous YouTubers from photos. Along the way, Tommy and Max also get into some of the biggest debates in YouTube history, including whether we need to bring proper YouTube apologies back, the golden era of diss tracks and what KSI leaving the Sidemen means for them.

programme.desc: Ne-Yo takes on The British Test, from making the perfect British cup of tea to trying Scampi Fries for the first time. The R&B superstar is thrown headfirst into UK culture, talks about what it means to perform in the UK, reveals why he'd love to be the 'Black Ed Sheeran', discusses what it's like to work with Pitbull, admits his crush on Leona Lewis, gives his thoughts on UK style, and hilariously trolls Jake Paul along the way.

programme.title: On The Ground At Tommy Robinson's Rally
programme.desc: Around 60,000 people gathered at Parliament Square on 16 May for Tommy Robinson's Unite The Kingdom rally, ostensibly to defend freedom, protect children, and take the country back. It was the smaller of two protests in central London, with at least a quarter of a million attending a pro-Palestine rally commemorating the 78th anniversary of the Nakba and uniting against the far-right. On the rally's main stage, a man covered in bacon played the cello.

programme.desc: Kneecap joined PoliticsJOE following the dismissal of their terror case against member Mo Chara in the British courts. The band discussed the legal proceedings, which centred on allegations that Chara displayed a Hezbollah flag during a London concert in November 2024. UK prosecutors had argued this could constitute an offence under the Terrorism Act, but the case was thrown out due to procedural failures.

programme.title: Glen Powell Takes The Irish Test

programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Ice Dogs
programme.desc: Conditions in the High Arctic are too extreme for either man or dog to survive alone but together we have become native to the vast white expanses. What's more, it's not just a food source, it's also a theatre many of nature's most dramatic spectacles play out in this breathtaking wilderness. We literally need grasslands to breathe, but they're a vital resource for some of our most exciting wildlife!

programme.title: Extinction! Going, Going, Gone

If we are to do anything to stem the tide of extinction we must understand the lifestyles of those in danger. The future for countless animals is uncertain, but one thing is for sure – we have a lot to learn.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yellowstone National Park is an American national park located in the western United States, largely in the northwest corner of Wyoming and extending into Montana, and Idaho. It was established by the U.S. Congress and signed into law by President Ulysses S. Grant on March 1, 1872. Yellowstone was the first national park in the U.S. and is also widely held to be the first national park in the world. The park is known for its wildlife and its many geothermal features, especially Old Faithful geyser, one of its most popular. While it represents many types of biomes, the subalpine forest is the most abundant. It is part of the South Central Rockies forests ecoregion.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is an American national park in the southeastern United States, with parts in Tennessee and North Carolina. The park straddles the ridgeline of the Great Smoky Mountains, part of the Blue Ridge Mountains, which are a division of the larger Appalachian Mountain chain. The park contains some of the highest mountains in eastern North America, including Clingmans Dome, Mount Guyot, and Mount Le Conte. The border between the two states runs northeast to southwest through the center of the park. The Appalachian Trail passes through the center of the park on its route from Georgia to Maine. With 12.5 million visitors in 2019, the Great Smoky Mountains National Park is the most visited national park in the United States.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: North America's National Parks are world famous and their breathtaking landscapes fascinate millions of visitors. This spectacular series will show you what happens beyond the lookouts. Everglades National Park is an American national park that protects the southern twenty percent of the original Everglades in Florida. The park is the largest tropical wilderness in the United States, and the largest wilderness of any kind east of the Mississippi River. An average of one million people visit the park each year. Everglades is the third-largest national park in the contiguous United States after Death Valley and Yellowstone. UNESCO declared the Everglades & Dry Tortugas Biosphere Reserve in 1976, and listed the park as a World Heritage Site in 1979, while the Ramsar Convention included the park on its list of Wetlands of International Importance in 1987. Everglades is one of only three locations in the world to appear on all three lists.

A few years later, the three are working on their joint feature film. They put all their eggs in one basket and are determined to invest two years of working time to achieve their goal. Unpaid. It's not just any goal: the three want to travel to Antarctica. They want to find out whether it is possible to reach even the most distant destinations if you only want to. With ten boxes full of equipment, they set off on the 14,000 km journey to Antarctica. And thus on the journey of a lifetime...

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: While Justin assembles the interior of our 1969 Charger R/T Special Edition, Mark and Doug complete the build of a 1966 Hemi. This 426 Hemi is connected to a 4 speed manual transmission, sitting in a rarely seen 1966 Dodge Charger. Even rarer, is the Charger's ZZ1 Gold Poly paint. Mark employs the fork-lift for maximum maneuverability of this massive engine, while Doug guides it past the pristine Poly paint. Doug's first Hemi install in a '66 Charger is bound to be memorable!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Running out of options, Will finally gets a new helper in the paint booth. But, his decades old habit may drive Will crazy. Mark and Tony do a deep-dive dissection of a Dodge Demon. Breaking down this very unique, 1971, Hemi Orange, 340, that could be only one of one ever made! Finally, Tony and Mark evaluate a beautiful 1970 Challenger R/T, 440 6 Pack, 4-speed, convertible! Rare, gorgeous, and one of Mark's favorite cars in the queue!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: A phantasm from Mark's past reaches out from the grave, prompting a road trip to acquire one of Mark's favorite cars! For Mark G. Worman, there is no better holiday to celebrate at the Graveyard than Halloween! Which is great for his cousin Dougie, who loves Halloween but not so great for Will and Allysa. Although they're more than familiar with Mark's Halloween antics, this year's celebration may have them reaching for a stake and a hammer!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The Ghoulz lay out and buff a beautiful paint job on Christine, and tease the remarkable rebirth of this movie-correct car! Justin forges ahead with the final assembly of the 1970 Tor Red roadrunner convertible and Mark demonstrates one of Mopar's mechanical masterpieces: the Air Grabber hood. Meanwhile, just when Will and Brody think it's safe to go back in the paint booth, Mark's out for blood! But will Mark's razor-sharp remarks and biting humor halt progress on the very unique 1971 roadrunner?

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The black 1971 Hemi 'Cuda tribute build is almost a roller! Will and his team are assembling the newly painted metal while Doug trains some new blood on assembling the remaining pieces of the 'Cuda's drivetrain. Meanwhile, Mark tests his daughter's Mopar expertise with a car that may or may not be carrying fake ID! programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Berrykins Ed and Earl report to Princess Berrykin and Strawberry that they are certain there is a monster in the berry patch! They saw something with many noses and many tails making weird noises in the bushes. But upon further investigation by Strawberry and her friends, it is discovered that friendly boy Huckleberry Pie was driving his pet-mobile of orphan dogs through the countryside, took a wrong turn and got stuck near Berry Bitty City.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry is disappointed in the girls' lack of enthusiasm for the Patti Persimmon mystery novels, her favorite book series. She finds herself missing the company of her fellow Persimmon fan Huckleberry, and thinks up a great way to get him to visit. She invites Huck to co-write a story with her to submit to an online mystery magazine.. Huck eagerly accepts and comes for a visit.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Mystery of the Disappearing Dog Show
programme.desc: When Huckleberry and Blueberry's Patti Persimmon-style mystery story is rejected by an online mystery magazine, Blueberry and Huck have to come up with a new way to raise support for Huckleberry's Hotel for Homeless Pets back in Berry Big City. Strawberry suggests they hold a big dog show! Plum makes over-ambitious plans to display talents that her dog does not quite have, trying to teach him complicated dance routines.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The Baby Berrykins are enthralled by a fairytale that Blueberry reads to them for Story Time. Charmed by their reaction, Strawberry suggests that the girls do a "berrytale play" for the kids, sort of a "Story Time On Stage." Plum volunteers to direct it. She envisions a small, simple production-until she hears about a gigantic production of "Snowberry and the Seven Berrykins" that's a smash hit in Berry Big City.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry and the girls excitedly plan to put on a "Story Time On Stage" musical play for the Berrykin kids: "Berryella and Prince Berry Charming," directed and choreographed by Plum, with musical direction by Cherry. Strawberry will play Berryella, with Lemon and Blueberry as her comically jealous stepsisters, and costume designer Raspberry as her Fairy Fashionmother.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry and Huck turn the Baby Berrykins' favorite fairy tale, "The Littlest Berrykin," into a comedy play. They pitch it to director Plum and the assembled cast and crew using a large storybook. As Huck and Blueberry narrate the story, we push in on the book and its illustrations transition into animation. In the story, the King and Queen of the Berry Patch (played by Huck and Blueberry) are retiring to the tropics.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Orange wants to spend the day teaching her puppy to fetch, but the frisky little gal doesn't seem to understand the "retrieve" part of the activity-as soon as she gets the ball, she runs out of sight and returns moments later without it. Orange gets a new ball and tries again, with the same results. Over and over, until Orange is out of balls. Puzzled and frustrated that she can't find where her pup has stashed them, she goes to enlist her friends to help her search.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is being driven to distraction! She can't finish a song that she promised to write for a singing group, thanks to the earsplitting noise from Berrykin construction crews who are trying to find the sparkleberry juice blockage that has shut down the town's power. Strawberry can't cook in the café, Lemon's hair salon appliances are running out of control-life in Berry Bitty City is impossible!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With the power completely out in Berry Bitty City, the girls go on a camping trip to be out of the way of the Berrykin work crews. Lemon is nervous because she believes there is a creepy creature in the forest (that she read about in a book Blueberry loaned her), and the girls get the nervous bug, but Strawberry turns their apprehension into fun by daring her friends to stay out in the woods the longest!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls are driven to distraction by their frisky puppies frolicking all over Berry Bitty City! Full of energy and thinking that everything in town is a toy for them to play with, they cause comical mayhem wherever they go. Strawberry suggests the pups need a place of their own where they can play, a dog park! The girls decide to call in Huckleberry, who runs an animal hotel in Berry Big City, to help design the park.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls plan a formal afternoon lawn party tea to inaugurate their new dog park. Plum is in charge of decorations, Cherry music, and Strawberry snacks. There's even a giant, dog-shaped ice sculpture. As the girls get dressed, Raspberry puts the finishing touches on the high-fashion hats that will accompany their beautiful gowns. At last everything is ready. But when the gate opens... the puppies back away!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: To convince the dance-averse Huckleberry to attend the big masquerade ball at the dog park, Blueberry promises she'll stay by his side the whole evening and make sure he doesn't have to dance. But as the day of the ball dawns, Blueberry awakens with a bad cold. She doesn't know how to tell Huck that she can't go to the ball. Lemon and Raspberry misinterpret her sniffles, thinking she's so heartbroken to be disappointing Huck that she's crying!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Berry Biggest, Berry Baddest Bakeoff
programme.desc: Berry Bitty City is abuzz as Berrykin Bloom introduces the biggest, juiciest, strangest fruit anyone has ever seen! programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Nick and Sally must protect their cookie jar from cookie snatchers! Then, the kids meet Treetop Tom and see how his tough tongue can pick food off of thorny branches.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Sally and Nick are pretending to swim but "why not go for a real swim" asks the Cat! Later, the children go on a trip to visit Princess Lottachoca in the Cocoalicious Forest.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Nick and Sally are try to guess what animal is the toughest one. Then, the Cat needs to get his fish friend, Ting Tang Tony, back to his family.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Sally and Nick go on a trip to Ozzie-Wozz Outback to help them look after some baby hamsters. Then, Nick and Sally wish they could go as fast as an airplane!

programme.title: Darkness Shall Rise
programme.desc: With the Devourer destroyed, Ninjago is saved and the rebuilding effort begins. Without their Golden Weapons, the Ninja are stripped of their elemental powers. And with their flying ship ‘The Destiny's Bounty' destroyed, the Ninja are forced to find a new home in the city. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon resurfaces and gains control of the Serpentine as well as transforms the Bounty's wreckage to become ‘The Black Bounty'. The Ninja will battle Scales and discover evil has begun to resurface in Ninjago, while Lord Garmadon will successfully forge the Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.Just as the rebuilding effort in Ninjago begins, the four ninjas come to realize that evil has started to resurface with Lord Garmadon forging the ninjas' lost Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.

programme.title: Pirates Vs. Ninja
programme.desc: When Garmadon by accident brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty – the ruthless Captain Soto and his Pirates - it is up to our ninjas to stop them from plundering Ninjago City. Sharing a tiny, one-bedroom apartment in the city, the Ninja take Lloyd to Grand Sensei Darreth's Mojo Dojo to begin training. There, they discover Lloyd has all four of their natural elemental abilities. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon discovers his Mega-Weapon can't destroy, only create what the user wishes. By accident, Garmadon brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty: Captain Soto and his Pirates, and they mutiny the ship. Answering the age-old question of who would win a fight between pirates and ninja, it's up to our ninja to stop Captain Soto and his men from plundering Ninjago City. In the end, Ninjago City is saved, the Pirates are arrested and Lord Garmadon escapes once again with their Black Bounty.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: When our heroes are invited back to Darkly's Boarding School, they discover it's a trap set up by Lord Garmadon and his evil replica ninjas created by Garmadon's new Mega-Weapo. Realizing how to correctly wield the Mega-Weapon, Lord Garmadon creates evil replicas of the Ninja to face off with our heroes. Meanwhile, Lloyd and the Ninja are invited back the Darkly's Boarding School, only to discover it's a trap and now the bad kids have seized control of the school. With the Ninja trapped in the school with the faculty, things spiral out of control as the Evil Replica Ninja arrive. As an awesome battle takes place in the school halls, the Ninja manage to outsmart their evil versions, and warn Lord Garmadon they're ready for whatever else he throws at them.

programme.title: Fright Knight
programme.desc: Using the Book of Fear, Jestro calls forth Whipperella and uses her to trap the knights in the dark woods where they realize their darkest fears. Searching through the dark forests of the realm, Jestro finds “The Book of Fear.” It's pretty scary. But he feeds it to the book of Book of Monsters, and he uses it to call forth WHIPPERELLA, a monster that can induce fear. One-by-one she uses her “knighmarish” power on the knights and they experiences their own worst fears. Clay fears not living up to the Knights' Code. Lance fears being a nobody. Macy fears never being a knight and Axl fears having no food. Aaron must take the lead because he's fearless he does everything with reckless abandon. It's not until he leads the group out of the forest – as they fight off the Whipperella – that they we find out Aaron's true fear – the fear of peace and quiet and no more challenges or high energy escapades.

programme.title: The Golden Castle
programme.desc: When Lance is cast as the star in the new remake of the classic movie “Ned Knightly and the Golden Castle” he doesn't anticipate Jestro and his monsters invading the set and ruining his starring role. It's movie time! Lance does something very Lance: he agrees to star in a movie about remake of a classic film in Knighton: “The Golden Castle.” While pillaging a village, Jestro and the Book of Monsters see a movie poster for “The Golden Castle” and the book says the legendary Golden Castle is filled with riches! Jestro explains that it's just a dumb movie and that it's not real. It's all based on a “script.” The Book, who's been shelved for many years, wants to eat the movie script to learn more about the modern world. On the set of the movie, Lance has invited the other Knights to act as extras. When they see how Lance is being portrayed, they're incensed. When Jestro attacks the movie set to get the script for his book to eat, the film director keeps rolling. This battle footage is fantastic! The Knights defeat Jestro even though the movie set is trashed. The director will make it work. At the premier of the movie, Lance is embarrassed to see that he's been reduced to comic relief for the realm's bravest Knight…Macy! The director has now made her a star.

programme.title: The Maze Of Amazement
programme.desc: The Knights find themselves trapped in a maze looking for the Book of Deception. But will they actually get their hands on it, or will it keep deceiving them? The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. After help from Axl's people to defeat Jestro and win the book, the knights discover it's a FAKE BOOK of deception. The Book of Deception created a fake copy of itself!

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: It seems the NEXO-Knights are attacking villages throughout the realm! But why? A mysterious Black Knight appears to defend the cities from the rogue NEXO-villains! Jestro, happy he has the REAL Book of Deception, uses it to create bad versions of the NEXO-Knights. The “fake” knights then attack villages and hamlets. When the real NEXO-Knights arrive, they're booed and pelted with food. Why does everyone hate them? To make matters more confusing, a giant Mech Suit in black – The BLACK KNIGHT – appears to defend the kingdom's villages from the fake knights. The Black Knight ends up being very powerful and throws Jestro and his fake knights for a loop. He's cool and mysterious. But when the fake Knights get the better of him, the REAL NEXO-Knights appear to fend them off and learn their deceptive secret. The Knights save the Black Knight and they open him up to find…young ROBIN! (He used a deep, deceptive voice.) The Knights realize that Robin has potential. But maybe he still has some learning to do.

programme.title: Chased Dreamers
programme.desc: To craft their own hourglasses and become official Dream Chasers for the Night Bureau, Mateo and his friends must defeat the Dream Forge guardian.

programme.title: The Dream Forge
programme.desc: As time runs out to face the Dream Forge and become official Dream Chasers, Mateo and his friends enlist the help of the mysterious Dream Bandit.

programme.title: Legendary Places, Ninjago's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Cole joins Jay and Zane inside the Nindroid to solve a mysterious puzzle and also Kai enters Zane's mind and suggests the Ninja take a break from puzzle-solving to figure out which villain is trying to hack their friend.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: Andrea's Big Moment
programme.desc: When famous pop star Livi comes to Heartlake City to judge a talent show, our five friends Olivia, Mia, Andrea, Emma and Stephanie all decide to enter – and one of them, in particular, really wants to win but faces some serious challenge from an old rival. A talent show has come to Heartlake City and all the girls enter the talent competition hoping to impress the judges, especially their idol, pop star Chloe. No one wants a shot at stardom more than Andrea, which is why the other girls are surprised when she doesn't show up to practice before the first round of the competition. Very nearly eliminated prior to the big show, Andrea panics and throws herself into an intense practice-training mode, even shutting her friends out when they're trying to help her with her performance. Just moments before her live TV debut, Andrea realizes she's missing a key element to her act. Can she pull it off without her friends? And are the other girls willing to help after being pushed away?

programme.title: Kate's Island
programme.desc: The five friends leave for science camp that takes place on an island and during the trip, they meet the stand-offish Kate – but they soon realize that there's more to her than meets the eyes and that you shouldn't judge the book by its cover. No one is more excited than Olivia about science camp at a beautiful rocky offshore island with a lighthouse. But Olivia quickly gets off on the wrong foot with a mysterious girl named Kate who seems obsessed with a medallion necklace and the island's rumored history of pirates and treasure. Even worse for Olivia, Kate seems to be growing extra chummy with Mia, even sneaking around the island with her late at night. With the help of Stephanie, Emma and Andrea, Olivia is determined to get to the bottom of the girls' secret friendship and find out once and for all what they're searching for on the island, but they better not let Mrs. Stevens catch them out of their cabin past curfew.

programme.title: The Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The five friends help out at The Grand Hotel that Andrea's family just bought during what was supposed to be a quiet weekend until a hotel critic arrives unexpectedly. The girls are ready to do everything to make a great impression – but things don't quite go according to plan. Andrea, Stephanie, Olivia, Emma and Mia have come for breakfast at the fanciest hotel in town, now owned by Andrea's family. When Andrea's aunt has to leave town, the girls volunteer to run the hotel for the weekend with the help of quirky Grandma Jean. This is the perfect job for Stephanie's expert managerial skills but then the hotel suddenly fills to capacity with guests, including a hotel critic that can make or break the hotel's reputation! Now the girls find themselves in over their heads juggling reception, childcare, food prep and waitressing, a dog-walking service and a testy chef who quits on them in the middle of dinner. Unfortunately, much of this is their own fault. Can the girls save the Grand Hotel from themselves?

programme.title: Ninjaball Run
programme.desc: When the ninja learn that Darreth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed and Darreth doesn't have the money to save it, our heroes enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win its cash prize in order to save the dojo. As Lloyd continues to train and unlock his hidden powers, the Ninja learn land developers are going to destroy Darreth's Mojo Dojo unless Darreth can find the money to save it. The Ninja decide to enter their Ninja Tank into the annual NinjaBall Run cross-country rally to try to win its cash prize. Revisiting past characters who also enter the race, the high-speed derby will only grow more dangerous as Garmadon enters his Black Bounty, realizing this is the perfect chance to use his Mega-Weapon and rid the ninja. In the end, the Ninja will discover a few secrets within their Ninja Tank, allowing them to beat Garmadon's Bounty by a millisecond and saving Darreth's Dojo with their well-deserved cash prize. And as a final surprise, the Ninja steal back the Destiny's Bounty and make it their own once again.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This tale tells us about one Caliph from the East, who used to sit all day long in front of the window and listen to the birds chirping. Caliph was very powerful, but there was one thing that disappointed him - he could not understand the birds' language. Poor Caliph began to cry and no one was able to make him laugh. One day a strange dwarf came to Caliph. He promised to help him to turn him into a stork. Caliph agreed and turned into a stork. Meanwhile, the dwarf sat on the throne and proclaimed himself Caliph. The poor Stork burst into tears and begged the dwarf to restore his human appearance and kingship. Nothing would have saved Caliph, if only one little parrot helped Caliph to bewitch the dwarf and return the human appearance to him. Masha concludes that it is very important to learn foreign languages.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a boy called Jack. He was so poor that no girl would want to marry him. One day he went to the market to sell the cow and buy himself a suit. On his way to the market Jack met an old man, who offered him to buy a cow for a bean seed. Jack agreed and went home. There he met his mother, who realized that money was spent for nothing and threw away the seed out from the window. At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This fairy tale is about one little and witty tailor, who had a chance to defeat the giant and obtain a fridge full of sweets. So he ate all of them at once. Then he decided to get out on the street, but could not, as he overate and got stuck in the door. This story teaches us a vital lesson not to be greedy and eat too much otherwise we might get into a messy situation.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Masha tells her version of the fairy tale about the poor girl called Cinderella. She lived with her stepmother who forced her to work till dawn. One day the stepmother asked Cinderella to crack three bags of nuts. The poor girl would never have managed to complete this task, if only the fairy had appeared in front of her. By magic, the fairy emerged and conjured her Nutcracker, who helped Cinderella to crack all the nuts very fast. The Cinderella was so happy that she took the Nutcracker with her to the ball, which took place in the royal palace. The Nutcracker helped the King to save the palace from rats and Cinderella was so thankful that she kissed him in his cheek. In this very moment the Nutcracker turned into a handsome prince! The moral of the story is that we should not judge the others by their appearance.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Who is the best cook in all the forest? Masha has no doubts as to how to correctly answer this question. And the proof is right before you: macaroni cooked by Masha herself. What can be simpler? Only Dasha is somehow sure that Masha's final product is inedible. As usual, Bear will have to solve the girls' dispute, as usual.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha enthusiastically plays with her "dolls", but Rosie wants to be independent. She trades places with wolves and now they are under Masha's care. Rosie enjoys adult life, but everything is not that simple ...

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The wolves come up with a new idea how to get a stable and nutritious food source… they rob a poultry farm and get a…rooster. Meanwhile Masha and the hare arrange a real egg hunt for all their friends and neighbours! All forest dwellers are very excited to get chocolate eggs except for the wolves who long for some real food… Masha decides to help poor guys and arranges a splendid dinner!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear's good friend, the Tiger, is back for a visit and they decide to spend the time together in an intellectual way – playing chess. Masha is immediately drawn into the game and to everyone's surprise, she outsmarts and outplays both the Bear and his friend with just one chess figure.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Bright summer day. Bear, while gathering berries, meets female bear in the forest and arranges a date with her. Returning home, he starts cleaning the house and baking a pie. Once the pie is done, the Bear decorates it with strawberries. Masha eats them before starting to hiccup. The Bear tries all manner of remedies from a medical encyclo-pedia to stop the hiccups. In the end, hiccups spread to everyone including all other forest in-habitants.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: How difficult it is to remain calm when two little tombs are raging in the house. Panda and Masha are fooling around for days. To cope with stress, Bear needs a good rest. Will he be able to restore internal forces or two fidgets will not give him peace?

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Female Bear presents Masha with a glamour magazine and now the Bear shall transform his house into a beauty salon. Get ready to learn a lesson that everything should be done with a sense of proportion, especially when it comes to beauty.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Autumn forest is so wonderful. You can pick mushrooms, listen to birds singing ... But what if there are absolutely no mushrooms at all? Masha finds an original solution to this problem. Which one? Watch the episode and find out!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Who wants to pimp a car? Then hurry up to stand in a queue! Why? Because in a new, 55th episode there are loads of unexpected things that happened in the forest: Masha appears as a first-rate mechanic , wolves who, obviously, decided to change their occupation appear as taxi drivers ... okay, okay… we should stop throwing spoilers around…watch everything yourself!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: A van with Monkeys arrived at the Bear's house. They invite everyone to test themselves with the help of an attraction - a power meter. The Bear is confident that he will easily win the main prize. But things didn't go according to plan. And now the main strongman of the forest cannot do without the help of his friends.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Can you imagine Masha as a magical fairy? What magic could she create? Of course something enchanting and fantastic! Especially when the Bear decided to cheer the Female Bear and organize a masquerade ball! Masha put all her efforts to create a bright, memorable and very harvest party, but this magic evening couldn't survive without Masha's tricks…

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha decides to help the Bear to win the heart of his beloved Female Bear. To do so, Masha organizes her own rock band and shoots a music video. The hare plays on drums, the wolves play on piano and Masha rocks out on a guitar! This is something that the forest inhabitants have never seen before.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear decides to harvest berries and to cook jam. This idea is literally up to Masha's taste. She tries everything. Afterwards she decides to play an astronaut by putting a glass jar on her head. The Bear tries to get her head out of the container and eventually he succeeds only to discover his own paw inside the same jar. He spends the remaining day in attempts to free his hand.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: What happens when bees overeat chocolates? Masha becomes their personal trainer! Get ready! Let's start weight loss exercises!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Oh, what a ripe, sweet, and beautifully-smelling raspberry! Masha has gone picking berries, but Bear had strictly forbidden it. Now she'll do anything to avoid admitting that she disobeyed him. The situation goes too far, and everyone in the forest gets involved in the debacle. So what will the strict Bear do?

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha dreams of royal life. She wants a luxurious palace and a chic car. She dreams to give orders and that all forest creatures execute them. She dreams to rule. Will these dreams come true and what does it really mean to live like a king? Watch and find out in the new episode.Masha dreams of royal life. She wants a luxurious palace and a chic car. She dreams to give orders and that all forest creatures execute them. She dreams to rule. Will these dreams come true and what does it really mean to live like a king? Watch and find out in the new episode.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Reverend Dwight Moore is at death's door when he is transferred from his local hospital to Memorial Hospital in Chapel Hill. With all the expertise and technology of modern medicine at their disposal, doctors are still unable to find of the cause of Moore's symptoms, which include stomach pain, numbness, and hallucinations. His devoted wife Blanche remains by his side throughout his puzzling illness. She tries to comfort him by bringing his favorite banana pudding from home. When Moore's vital functions begin to shut down, a visiting specialist examines him and notices white striation lines on his fingernails, an indication of arsenic poisoning. Tests reveal that Moore has ingested more arsenic than any living person on record. Police investigators question him about his wife and discover that Blanche Moore's two previous husbands both met untimely deaths. Their bodies are exhumed and found to contain high levels of arsenic, and Blanche Moore is convicted of murder and sentenced to death.

Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA

The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.
